why: philologist-placeholders-2: electricity is the main Afghan sense (برق رفت 'the power went out'); the card said only lightning in lx-6349, lx-1325, lx-1199, lx-1995, lx-0891 and lx-1930
philologist-placeholders-3: the primary meaning is weight (وزن کردن, to weigh); lx-6429's sentence resolved to a card saying 'meter (poetry)'
philologist-placeholders-5: بحر is the Dari word for sea (دریا is river); lx-6470's starfish lived in a poetic meter
philologist-placeholders-1: صدا is first sound, noise; voice is one sense
philologist-placeholders-2: قورباغه is the general or formal word for frog; toad was chosen only to keep it apart from بقه (lx-6312)
philologist-placeholders-2: آهو is a gazelle; deer is گوزن (lx-1566)
philologist-placeholders-4: a learner looking up خیار expects the Iranian 'cucumber'; in Dari that is بادرنگ, and this entry is the legal term. Headword translit also lacked the ā its own example has

set.glossEn: option, right of withdrawal (law; not cucumber - in Dari that is بادرنگ)
